design: All13 H827 groups and block/random directions. At first downstream MLP cross each of4 natural raw baselines with each of4 captured incoming central derivatives. No averaged/off-data baseline.
derivative: u=b/r; q=v/r-b*mean(b*v)/r^3; r=sqrt(mean(b^2)+float32eps). Output D[(Lu)*(Rq)+(Lq)*(Ru)]. Double precision math with fixed model weights.
comparisons: Own diagonal; hold each baseline fixed across4 inputs; hold each input fixed across4 baselines. Average six cosines and all4 reference choices without selecting best. Additional normalizer-vs-bilinear-state decomposition at fixed raw input direction.
scope: Analytic local module sensitivity, not whole-model causal mediation or semantic feature discovery. Incoming v is captured finite central derivative; verify natural replay and finite differences.
